title: TOC Exact Table Parity
summary: Fixed TOC/Glossary/Reference longtable parity with Netzwerk short tables: (1) register colspecs now compute inner width after table body font selection with measured padding/rule widths, zero tabcolsep, and @{} between columns; (2) long-mode rows use literal \hline via \semio@table@row@long instead of global-boolean-gated \noalign{\hrule}, preserving 12-page pagination; (3) short tabular tables unchanged via \semio@table@row@short. Verified light+dark builds (12 pages), per-row hairlines, right border alignment, and bottom closing rule on last TOC page.
